Marta R.: Heads-up: I'm drafting a concrete dry-run playbook for peering cutovers where we want zero-app-visible downtime. Need to capture handshake ordering, traffic pinning, and rollback triggers.
Eli W.: Important: control-plane split (controlplane in prod vs tenant VPC peer) should be invisible to data-plane. We need a deterministic tie-breaker for dual-paths so flows don’t oscillate.
Samir K.: Proposed tie-breaker: prefer direct-peer for TCP established connections, prefer relay for new connections when route RIB is unstable.
Priya V.: How do we detect RIB instability? Add a route-flap counter with 10s decay and threshold=3 to mark a route degraded.
Marta R.: Good. Also need connection pinning during cutover window: keep existing TCP connections pinned to their original NAT mapping for 120s after path change.
Eli W.: Operator CLI mock:
```
redwoodctl tenants cutover start --tenant=acme-42 --mode=mirror --hold-seconds=300 --pin-sec=120
```
Samir K.: Mirror mode = duplicate outbound on both peer and relay but do not ACK duplicates back to client. That requires path-level sampler and metric dedupe.
Priya V.: Dedupe strategy: attach header `X-Cutover-Session: <uuid>`; aggregator treats same uuid within window as one logical request for billing.
ci-bot: smoke-test: tenant-acme-42 cutover mirror run started, pipeline #5423 queued
Marta R.: Cert rotation is a footgun. Plan: for cutover dry-run, freeze cert pushes for the tenant for duration +/- 10m and force-stagger any infra-wide CA changes.
Eli W.: We also need KV cache sync semantics: writes during mirror mode must be applied to both sides synchronously or risk staleness. Suggest write-ahead log replication with ack quorum=2 before replying.
Samir K.: That will add latency; make it opt-in per-tenant in operator API: `kv_sync=best_effort|sync_quorum`
Priya V.: Observability checklist: emit events - `cutover.started`, `cutover.route_flap`, `cutover.pinned_conn_count`, `cutover.kv_lag_ms`. Dashboards should show both peer/relay error rates side-by-side.
Marta R.: Rollback triggers: >1% 5m error spike, any src_ip_preservation=false for >0.1% sampled requests, or autoscaler instability (thrash >2 scale ops in 5m).
Eli W.: Add an automated rollback job that reverses operator flags and drains new connections using `drain_mode=fast|graceful`.
Samir K.: For billing: emit `cutover_sample=false|true` and post-process to avoid charging duplicate tokens; engineering billing team needs a dedupe pass that groups by token+cutover_uuid in window.
Priya V.: Test plan: traffic replay using production-sized samples but with scaled-down rates, verify TCP pinning, verify route-flap detection, and verify metrics dedupe. Add a canary list: acme-qa, acme-staging, acme-enterprise.
Marta R.: Dry-run schedule: Tue 09:30 PT (30m). Deliverables before run: runbook, operator CLI, smoke tests in CI, prewarm plan for relay (2x baseline for 15m), SNAT reservation script.
Eli W.: I'll implement the CLI and a `--dry-run` flag that only emits events and simulator traces.
Samir K.: I'll own the sampler+dedupe changes and the connection pinning implementation.
Priya V.: I'll add observability panels and the rollback automation.
ci-bot: smoke-test: pipeline #5423 passed basic connectivity checks, waiting on full replay job
Marta R.: Perfect. I'll write up the playbook (sequence diagram + failure scenarios) and share RFC tag @eng-platform @infra. Any concerns?
Eli W.: None from me.
Samir K.: No objections.
Priya V.: Looks good. :rocket:
